Apple announces 'Pro and Tell' event for October 28

Apple has announced a product launch event titled 'Pro and Tell' scheduled for October 28. The event is expected to take place in Los Angeles. Analysts anticipate the unveiling of new devices, with specific expectations including an OLED MacBook Pro and potentially an iPad Mini. Some reports also suggest the possibility of a touchscreen laptop being introduced.
